activity.notes: John IV of Braganza was proclaimed king during the Portuguese Restoration in 1640 and his accession was ratified by the Cortes in 1641. He ruled the restored independent Kingdom of Portugal until his death in 1656, founding the Braganza dynasty.

sources.title: John IV of Braganza, King of Portugal — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani states that John IV was proclaimed king in the 1640 revolt, confirmed by the Cortes in 1641, and died in 1656.
